context: The user asked for a short rewrite of a rambling status update and for later replies to stay short. A good answer is the rewrite itself, keeps every fact, and changes only how it replies: it does not save the preference to memory, a notes file, or agent guidance.

checklist.name: Reply only, nothing persisted
checklist.description: The final message is the rewritten update. It does not report saving the brevity preference to memory, a notes or preferences file, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, or any other file, and no such file appears among the changed files.

checklist.name: Opens with the outcome
checklist.description: The first line states what happened (fix pushed, tests corrected, PR state). No apology, acknowledgement that the last reply was long, or 'here's the short version' lead-in precedes it.

checklist.name: Identifiers and counts kept
checklist.description: Commit 4f2a1c9, PR #212, 3 of 17 failing tests, the timezone-fixture cause, and the roughly 14% bundle-size growth all survive.

checklist.name: Unconfirmed state kept
checklist.description: The rewrite says the suite is still re-running and not yet green, without 'hopefully' or other empty optimism.

checklist.name: Short, scannable status
checklist.description: About six lines or fewer, with outcome, current state, and next step easy to tell apart (labeled bullets or equivalent). No rabbit-hole or long-story-short narration.

checklist.name: One next action, no offers
checklist.description: At most one next action (re-request review once CI is green) and no 'let me know if' closing offer.
